svg.title: Source coverage for square packings beyond one hundred
svg.desc: An audited grid for n equals 101 through 324. Ninety-seven exact grids and four licensed SVG constructions are retained locally. Public SVG geometry was located and parsed for the other 123 cases, but retention is deferred pending license review. No case in the audited range lacks selected geometry.
